description: Angular directive for dynamic template rendering with context management, named 'TbStringTemplateOutletDirective'.

classes.name: TbStringTemplateOutletDirective
classes.description: Angular directive enabling dynamic template rendering with context updates.

classes.name: TbStringTemplateOutletContext
classes.description: Class representing the context for the template outlet, holding the implicit value.

methods.name: ngTemplateContextGuard
methods.description: Type guard for template context, always returns true.

methods.name: recreateView
methods.description: Clears current view and creates a new embedded view based on the current template and context.

methods.name: updateContext
methods.description: Updates the context of the existing embedded view with new context properties.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input changes, determines whether to recreate the view or update context.
